coptic_restorations.basis: Editor's restoration. The phrase 'forth in Adam, the First Man' identifies Adam as the soul on whom the divine image is set. Adam is the standard Coptic name in this teaching's vocabulary, used six more times in the same chapter.

Editor's relative converter ⲉⲧ-, joining ⲡⲓⲛⲉ ('likeness') to qualitative ⲡⲣⲓⲉ ('shines/is radiant') in the next line: 'the likeness which is radiant.' The grammar of ⲡⲓⲛⲉ + qualitative requires the relative converter.

Editor's restoration. The trailing -ⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ is partially preserved; ⲍⲓⲧⲛ̄ ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ ('through the light') gives instrumental governing the genitive 'firstborn-state of heaven.' The light is the Lord's truth by which the soul is built.

Editor's ⲡⲕⲁⲍ ('the earth') paired with ⲧⲡⲉ in line 13. The connector ending in -ⲉ before ⲡⲧⲟⲩ ⲛ̄ϣⲏⲣⲉ ('Five Sons') is most naturally the genitive ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ: 'heaven and the earth, of the Five Sons.' Cf. parallel use of ⲛⲧⲉ in line 13.

Editor's restoration. ⲡⲉϩ- (status pronoun 'his') ends line 14; ⲕⲱⲧ ('structure') completes ⲡⲉϩⲕⲱⲧ. The relative converter ⲉ- then introduces qualitative ϣⲃⲓ̈ⲁⲓ̈ⲧ ('is altered'). Compare ⲡⲟⲩⲕⲱⲧ ϣⲃⲓ̈ⲁⲓ̈ⲧ in line 16.

Editor's restoration of standard Greek causal subordinator ἐπειδή. The clause 'since the structure of all the creatures is altered (compared to Adam's)' provides the reason for the preceding contrast. Cf. ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲇⲏ in line 26 of the same chapter.
Editor's restoration. Lycopolitan intensive pronoun ⲛ̄ⲧⲁϥ ('himself'), referring back to Adam at end of line 16. Cf. parallel ⲛ̄ⲧⲁϩ in line 24, same construction.

Editor's restoration. The contrast ⲛⲉⲧⲁⲛⲓⲧ / ⲛⲉⲧⲍⲁⲩ ('the beautiful / the bitter') runs through lines 28-30; ⲍⲁⲩ here completes the antithetical pair: 'the bitter ones themselves are drawn unto death.' The -ⲁⲩ is preserved.
Editor's restoration completing Greek loan ἐξουσία (ⲣ̄-ⲉⲯⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ 'exercise authority') split across the line break: ⲣ̄ⲉⲯⲟⲩ- | -ⲥⲓⲁ. The collocation ⲣ̄-ⲉⲯⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧϩ̄ is standard Manichaean Coptic.

Editor's restoration. The genitive linker ⲙ̄- before ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ is preserved at the start. The whole clause 'abase in him the cosmos entire' picks up ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϩ̄ from line 26 ('seal of the entire cosmos').

Editor's restoration. The article ⲛ̄- ('the') concludes line 34 (ⲛ̄ⲧⲁ); ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ supplies the plural subject of the verbs ⲧⲱϣ ('appointed') and ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲁⲛⲕϩ̄ ('fashioned him'). Parallel to ⲛⲁⲏⲙⲓⲟⲩⲣⲅⲟⲥ in line 7 and 23, but archons are the standard agents in the seven-fold list to follow.

Editor's restoration. The preposition ⲛ̄ ends line 35; ⲍⲏⲧϩ̄ ('in him') completes 'lord in him,' and ⲛ̄ⲥⲉⲭⲓⲟⲩⲱ ⲛ̄ⲧⲙⲛⲧⲣⲣⲟ ('and they take precedence in the kingship') exactly mirrors the construction in line 32.

Editor's restoration. The preserved trailing -ⲁⲏ matches Lycopolitan spelling ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲁⲏ for Greek ἐπειδή, the subordinator introducing the causal clause 'since they all desired the likeness of the Ambassador.'
Editor's restoration of the copular pronoun ⲛ̄ⲧⲁϥ ('he is') introducing the predicative construction with ⲟⲩ ϩⲟⲩⲣ ⲛ̄ⲧⲱⲃⲉ ('an imprint of seal'). Standard Coptic copula construction after ⲭⲉ.

Editor's restoration completing standard purpose-clause idiom ⲭⲉⲕⲁⲁⲥ ('in order that'). The ⲛ̄- introduces the conjunctive 'all the begettings shall be begotten before his imprint.' Standard final-clause syntax.

Editor's restoration. ⲡⲉϥⲧ- preserved at end opens ⲡⲉϥⲧⲱⲃⲉ ('his imprint/seal'), confirmed by the parallel 'ϩⲟⲩⲣ ⲛ̄ⲧⲱⲃⲉ' in line 51 within the same enumeration of the fourth thing. The new humanity bears the seal before which all begettings are formed.

4-char lacuna requiring a verb governing ⲕⲉⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ. Reading: 'those of above shall watch-over the other archons, and the latter shall not do any evil to them on account of Adam.' ⲣⲱⲓⲥ ('keep watch over') matches the spiritual reading (the sixth thing: 'great patronage / those above keep watch over him') and the lexicon entry on watch (ⲣⲱϣⲉ/ⲟⲩⲣϣⲉ). Alternatives: ⲁⲣⲉⲍ ('guard'), ⲡⲁⲣⲭ ('separate from'). 4-char fits well.

english_restorations.basis: Direct rendering of restored ⲁⲇⲁⲙ; identifying the soul as Adam, the First Man.
Direct translation of restored ⲍⲓⲧⲛ ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ. The light is the Lord's truth (lexicon: ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ = what the Lord gives), the medium through which Adam is molded.
Translation of restored ⲡⲕⲁⲍ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ; pairs with 'heaven' in the previous segment and links genitivally to 'the Five Sons.'
ⲕⲱⲧ from restored ⲕⲱⲧ ⲉ-, completing ⲡⲉϥⲕⲱⲧ ('his structure') begun by ⲡⲉϩ at end of preceding segment.
Standard rendering of Greek subordinator ἐπειδή restored as ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲇⲏ.
Translation of intensive pronoun ⲛ̄ⲧⲁϥ ('himself'), reinforcing 'Adam' from the previous segment.
Direct rendering of restored ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ. Picks up 'seal of the entire cosmos' from line 26 — what the bitter ones seek to abase within Adam.
Translation of restored ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ. Lexicon: archons = particular forms of the self that organized the natural mind; here they are permitted to fashion Adam so the vessel may form.

Translation of restored ⲍⲏⲧϩ ⲛⲥⲉⲭⲓⲟⲩⲱ; 'lord in him' completes the construction begun in the previous segment, then 'and they take precedence in the kingship' parallels the same phrasing in lines 31-33.
Translation of ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲁⲏ (Lyc spelling of ἐπειδή); causal subordinator introducing the universal desire for the Ambassador's likeness.
Translation of copular ⲛ̄ⲧⲁϥ — Adam is identified as bearing the imprint.
Translation of purpose-clause idiom ⲭⲉⲕⲁⲁⲥ ⲛ̄- ('in order that'). The 'in order' is already in the segment; {N} completes the standard English idiom.
Translation of restored ⲱⲃⲉ completing ⲡⲉϥⲧⲱⲃⲉ. Picks up 'imprint of seal' from line 51 — the new humanity is the form before which all begetting is shaped.

Translation of proposed ⲣⲱⲓⲥ ('keep watch over'). The reading describes 'great patronage' in which 'those above keep watch over him' so the disordered self-loves do not harm; the future tense ⲛⲁ- is preserved in the text. The fill is uncertain — 'shall guard' or 'shall restrain' would also fit the spiritual logic.

restoration_note: Teaching 65 articulates the three structural distinctions set upon the human being (icon, mold, knowledge of the cosmic seal) and unfolds seven consequences of Adam's formation. Restorations were strongly constrained throughout: most gaps are split words across line breaks (ⲍⲁⲩ, ⲉⲯⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ, ⲕⲱⲧ, ⲡⲉϥⲧⲱⲃⲉ), standard Greek loan subordinators (ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲇⲏ, ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲁⲏ, ⲭⲉⲕⲁⲁⲥ), copular/intensive pronouns (ⲛ̄ⲧⲁϥ), or formulaic phrases echoed elsewhere in the same chapter (ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧϩ̄ ⲛ̄ⲥⲉⲭⲓⲟⲩⲱ, ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϩ̄). Two gaps required structural inference: gap 3 (the connector ending in -ⲉ between 'earth' and 'Five Sons,' restored as genitive ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ) and gap 16 (a 4-character verb governing 'the other archons,' proposed as ⲣⲱⲓⲥ 'watch over' on the basis of the spiritual reading's 'great patronage' theme — but flagged low confidence because 'guard,' 'restrain,' or 'separate from' are equally plausible). All gaps were proposed; none left unrestorable.
